name: Purchase Order Tracker
purpose: Tracks each purchase order line from order to goods receipt and invoice, with spend per vendor and buyer

inputs.export_row_index: Row number left over from an earlier export of the file, not an ID of anything
inputs.line_item: Line number within the purchase order
inputs.vendor_id: ID of the vendor in the ERP system
inputs.buyer_name: Name of the purchasing officer who raised the order
inputs.unit_of_measure: Unit the quantity is in, e.g. each, kg or rolls
inputs.line_total: Total for the line after discount: quantity times unit price
inputs.unit_price: Price for one unit of the material
inputs.currency: Currency of the prices on the line
inputs.po_date: Date the purchase order was created
inputs.requested_delivery_date: Date the material was asked to be delivered by
inputs.plant: Code of the plant that receives the goods
inputs.line_status: Status of the line: open, partly received, closed or cancelled
inputs.payment_terms: How many days the company has to pay the vendor
inputs.discount_pct: Discount on the line, as a percentage
inputs.urgent_flag: Whether the order is urgent and needs to be sped up
inputs.vendor_invoice_no: Number of the vendor's invoice for the goods received
inputs.requisition_no: Number of the purchase request the order was raised from
inputs.line_value_usd: Line total converted to US dollars
